explanation: This tests surface flux integrals, absent from the supplied Linear Algebra topics, so it is prerequisite. For the upper paraboloid, the outward vector area element is ⟨2x,2y,1⟩ dA, giving integrand 2x(9−x²−y²)+x. The bottom plane contributes −x, so the combined integrand is 18x−2x³−2xy², option c. Other expressions odd in x also integrate to the same zero flux over the disk D; c directly expresses the combined surface contributions.
